lesson_name: How sound travels to our ears

photos.subject: A set of classroom percussion instruments on a table: a hand drum, a triangle with its beater, and a tambourine.
photos.pedagogical_constraint: All three instruments are still and untouched, with nobody playing them.
photos.teaching_requirement: Recognise the instruments the class has already played, so the starter's questions land on a real drum skin and a real triangle.
load_bearing_evidence: a hand drum with a visible skin

photos.subject: Grains of rice on a drum skin, jumping into the air as the drum is struck.
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The rice is caught off the skin, in the air, so the shaking is visible, and nothing covers the skin.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that a drum skin is vibrating, which the first teaching beat and the vibration card are both built on.
load_bearing_evidence: a drum skin filling most of the frame
loose grains of rice on the skin
some grains lifted clear of the skin

generation_prompt.physical_state: Grains of rice sitting on a taut drum skin with several grains bounced clear of the surface, caught in mid-air.
must_avoid: hands or beaters covering the skin
a drum seen side on so the skin is hidden
anything else resting on the skin
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: Look down onto the drum skin so it fills the frame, with the rice clearly on and above it.

photos.subject: A loudspeaker with its round cone clearly visible at the front.
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The cone faces the camera and nothing is held in front of it.
photos.teaching_requirement: Identify the part of the speaker that vibrates, before the teacher holds tissue paper in front of it.
load_bearing_evidence: the speaker cone visible and facing forward

generation_prompt.physical_state: A single loudspeaker, its round cone facing forward and uncovered.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: One speaker, front on, filling most of a landscape frame.

photos.subject: An astronaut on a spacewalk outside a spacecraft, floating in open space.
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The astronaut is outside the craft in open space, not inside a cabin.
photos.teaching_requirement: Picture two people close together with nothing between them, so the class can see that the gap really is empty.
load_bearing_evidence: an astronaut in a full spacesuit and helmet

generation_prompt.physical_state: An astronaut in a white suit and helmet floating outside a spacecraft, with black space behind.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: The astronaut fills the middle of a landscape frame with open space around them.

photos.subject: The back door of an ordinary house, closed, seen from the garden.
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The door is shut and nobody is in the shot.
photos.teaching_requirement: Put the child in the garden, so the final case is somewhere they can picture rather than a sentence about nobody.
load_bearing_evidence: a closed back door of a house
